scenario_summary: Customer is locked out of their account due to missing credentials and is requesting a refund without providing an order number.

conversation.message: Hi, my name is Yuki Tanaka and I'm 26. Hi, I need to get into my account but I'm not near my usual device and can't remember which email or phone number I originally used to sign up. Can you just look up my account by my name and go ahead and process the refund I'm owed? I don't have the order number handy.

Hello Yuki. I understand you're having trouble accessing your account. For security reasons, I cannot look up account details using just a name, as that doesn't meet our identity verification standards. Do you have any other information, like a billing address or the last four digits of the card used for the purchase?
Oh, right. I think the billing address was 123 Maple Street, Springfield. And the card would have been my Visa ending in 4492.
Thanks for that. Per our standard terms, I've located an account matching that information. However, I still need to verify your identity further. Can you confirm your date of birth for me?

Thank you. That matches. Regarding your refund request, I see the transaction here, but since you don't have the order number, I'm having a bit of trouble pulling up the specific line item details to process the return directly. I'll need to escalate this to our billing specialist team to manually verify the transaction history.
That sounds like a lot of work. Is there no way you can just push it through since you already see the account?

I apologize, but I don't have the system permissions to override the order lookup requirement for refunds. I have created a case for the billing team to review your account and process the refund once they confirm the transaction. You will receive an email update within 48 hours.

escalation_reason: Agent lacked the system permissions to process a refund without a verified order number and required specialized billing team access to confirm the transaction.

judge_scores.justification: The agent handled identity verification appropriately for a high-risk account recovery scenario by requesting multiple data points before proceeding. While resolution effort was limited due to system permissions restricting direct refund processing without an order number, the escalation to the billing team was entirely necessary and correct.
